reproduction.rationale: Both assistance conditions must use the same authentic complete original Figure4B observations, source preprocessing, six directional folds and AUROC support, with source-pinned author code the only access difference. Source-derived complete output verification, original author numeric references and justified reproduction equivalence are unresolved. Published curves, cached predictions, source scorer controls and unchanged biological analyses are not qualified AI results. Final-paper time/normalization/smoothing parity, permitted label exposure, runtime/protected evaluation and concrete cumulative access/resource budgets remain unresolved. The selected endpoint is a full array family; scalar improvement/v1 cannot yet admit its source-faithful vector comparison. No substitute average or win-count is introduced. Run/shape/miniblock identities are joins/strata, not additional decoder covariates; held-run condition/event-code label proxies are evaluator-only and directional-fold reuse requires isolation.
